$comment: Part I Section B — form-structure lens for the contracting authority. Fields follow the Schematron-mandated minimum; `required` reflects the rule severity (fatal -> required, warning -> optional).
title: Identity of the procurer
description: Identify the contracting authority or contracting entity running this procurement procedure.

fields.description: Official name of the contracting authority or contracting entity (BR-REQ-20-02, fatal).
Country of the contracting authority (BR-REQ-20-03, fatal).
Party identifier value. Recommended but not fatal (BR-REQ-20-04, warning).
The scheme the identifier belongs to (NATIONAL, LEI, BRIS, DUNS, VAT). Required once an identifier value is given.
